correctness.rationale: Exact pairwise directed-arc incompatibilities are proved and checked; the end reflection has two-arc orbits with a precise admissibility inequality, and orbit-barycenter coordinates give the actual geometric fixed locus. The resulting bipartite width-one conflict graph folds, through explicit conical-link deletions, to ceil(t/2) disjoint edges, proving the sphere homotopy type for every n. Integral Lefschetz theory and the published ambient rank-one homology give the mod-eight sign. A standalone check reconstructed all orbit faces for n=3..13 and verified 120 fold graphs with 3,600 valid vertex-pair deletions; no finite experiment is substituted for the general proof.

value.rationale: A natural reflection of the first all-width bidirected linear family studied in the January 2026 paper has fixed spaces of unbounded sphere dimension, sharply different from the ambient half-length sphere. An explicit PL orbit model and all-length simplicial collapse determine geometric topology, and the periodic integral homology sign supplies an additional symmetry invariant not implied by ambient Betti numbers. The parameter is canonically the number of edges, with no artificial finite slice.
